no-restricted-syntax.message: Use `OAuthProtocolError.is(x)` / `McpToolError.is(x)`, never `instanceof`. Next builds a separate bundle per route, so these classes exist as several distinct objects at runtime and `instanceof` compares identity between them — it returns false for a genuine error that crossed a bundle boundary. This passes in dev (one bundle) and fails only in production; it already shipped once, proven live 2026-07-29. See the Symbol.for note in mcp-oauth.service.ts.
